flavor.phonemic_palette: germanic (continental / Gothic register: thiudans/reiks, dithematic -s/-az names, retained th/w, ai/au diphthongs, heavy root-initial stress) / near_eastern (akkadian: the alu/bit river-cities, the sangu temple-priesthood, construct-chain toponyms, emphatic gutturals, SOV agglutinative grammar)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Ashurings — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Ashurings are a warlike martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Shamhar and Thiodons [Conquest Aristocracy (thiodons over shamhar)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, chariots, archers. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
